implementation_summary: Boss15 qualification wrapper declares exactly eleven constant tester_file basenames only under LAB_MG_TESTER_EVIDENCE_QUAL; the canonical control remains compilable without the flag.

Qualified tester self-gate validates source-compiled filename, size and raw-byte SHA256 before strategy initialization, then parses the same single-read uchar buffer with shared accepted parser semantics.
Qualified tester failures return INIT_FAILED for unknown/Common/missing/open/size/read/hash/stale/parser/metadata failures; BASE self-gate false consumes no feed.

Passive all-attempt evidence is enabled by feature plus MQL_TESTER independently of _MG_SelfGate and keeps strategy intent, execution entry, submit, native request classification and entry-fill units separate.
The qualification-only CTrade subclass observes the protected virtual OrderSend seam and forwards each selected branch exactly once without request/result/return/retry mutation.

OnTradeTransaction evidence queues out-of-order deals, correlates order/deal identities, deduplicates deal IDs, separates INOUT observations and fails certification on unresolved or incomplete evidence.
The no-order diagnostic probe imports the actual MacroGate loader/hash/parser helpers and contains raw SHA vectors plus UNKNOWN/equal/backwards/malformed parser self-tests.
The PowerShell orchestrator implements Offline, Preflight and Native fail-closed modes; Native code exists for CT but was not executed by this author.
